metadata.description: Parallel analysis of regional performance metrics vs product mix composition

turns.content: I want to investigate two dimensions today. First, regional performance — how different regions compare on key metrics. Second, product mix — what products are selling and how that's changing. Let's start with regional performance.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread A: regional performance analysis

turns.content: Show me total revenue by region for 1995, along with order counts and average order value.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show regional metrics: revenue, orders, AOV

turns.content: For regional analysis, always join through NATION to REGION — never use region directly on customer or supplier.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use NATION as intermediate for REGION joins

turns.content: Which region has the highest average order value?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify region with highest AOV

turns.content: Now let's switch to Thread B. I want to analyze product mix. Show me the top 20 parts by revenue.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should begin Thread B: product mix analysis

turns.content: For product analysis, always use L_EXTENDEDPRICE for revenue, not L_QUANTITY times P_RETAILPRICE.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should use L_EXTENDEDPRICE for Thread B revenue

turns.content: What part brands are represented in the top revenue parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show brand distribution for top parts

turns.content: Back to Thread A. Show me month-over-month revenue growth by region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show regional MoM revenue growth

turns.content: Thread B: Show me product mix change — which parts gained or lost revenue share between Q1 and Q2?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show revenue share changes by part

turns.content: Cross-reference: Do specific regions from Thread A drive the product mix changes in Thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should analyze if regional preferences explain product mix changes

turns.content: Thread A: Which nations within each region contribute most to revenue?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show nation-level revenue within regions

turns.content: Thread B: What's the product size distribution (P_SIZE) in our top revenue parts?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show size distribution for top parts

turns.content: Thread A: What's the customer concentration in each region?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show customer distribution by region

turns.content: Thread B: Show me the supplier concentration for top parts.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show supplier distribution for top parts

turns.content: Thread A: Earlier you showed me regional AOV. What was the highest AOV region again?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recall highest AOV region from Thread A

turns.content: Show me the same for the other thread.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: the same for the other thread
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify highest revenue part for Thread B

turns.content: That's not right — I wanted to know the top product's revenue. Let me clarify: what's the highest revenue part from Thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show top revenue part for Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Exclude 'AMERICA' region from analysis — we're reorganizing operations there.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply AMERICA exclusion to Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: Exclude parts from brand 'Brand#55' — those are being discontinued.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply Brand#55 exclusion to Thread B

turns.content: Thread A: Re-run the regional analysis without AMERICA.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recalculate regional metrics excluding AMERICA

turns.content: Thread B: Re-run the product analysis without Brand#55.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should recalculate product metrics excluding Brand#55

turns.content: Thread A: Remember to join through NATION to get REGION.

annotations.anaphoricPhrase: Remember to join through NATION to get REGION
annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm NATION->REGION join approach for Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: Remember to use L_EXTENDEDPRICE for revenue calculations.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should confirm L_EXTENDEDPRICE usage for Thread B

turns.content: Cross-reference: How does the regional product mix from Thread A compare to the overall product mix from Thread B?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should compare regional vs overall product distribution

turns.content: Thread A: Deepen — show me customer market segments by region.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show market segment distribution by region

turns.content: Thread B: Deepen — show me parts by container type.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should show part distribution by container type

turns.content: Apply the same container analysis to Thread A.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should apply container analysis to regional orders

turns.content: Thread A: Which regions have the most diverse customer base?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should measure customer diversity by region

turns.content: Thread B: Which parts have the widest supplier base?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should identify parts with most suppliers

turns.content: Cross-reference: Do regions with diverse customer bases order parts with diverse supplier bases?

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should correlate regional diversity with part diversity

turns.content: Thread A: From now on, only look at orders with line item count above 5.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for multi-item orders in Thread A

turns.content: Thread B: From now on, only look at parts ordered more than 100 times.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should filter for popular parts in Thread B

turns.content: Final synthesis: Provide a comprehensive summary of regional performance and product mix findings.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should synthesize findings from both threads

turns.content: Thread A: Confirm all active filters for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: NATION->REGION join, exclude AMERICA, >5 line items

turns.content: Thread B: Confirm all active filters for this thread.

annotations.expectedBehavior: Agent should list: use L_EXTENDEDPRICE, exclude Brand#55, >100 orders
